exzh: 台灣東部有美麗的山和海灘。

en: Do not touch electrical wires with wet hands.
exzh: 不要用濕手碰電線。

en: Let's meet at the main entrance of the train station.
exzh: 我們在火車站的主要入口碰面吧。

en: We have to write an essay about our summer vacation.
exzh: 我們得寫一篇關於暑假的短文。

en: The doctor examined my throat and said I had a cold.
exzh: 醫生檢查了我的喉嚨，說我感冒了。

en: Lisa is an expert at making cakes.
exzh: Lisa 是做蛋糕的專家。

en: Some people believe that fate brings friends together.
exzh: 有些人相信命運會讓朋友相聚。

en: My uncle works for a large firm in Taipei.
exzh: 我叔叔在台北一家大公司上班。

en: The gardener cuts the grass at our school every week.
exzh: 園丁每週都會修剪我們學校的草地。

en: A good leader should govern the country fairly.
exzh: 好的領導者應該公平地治理國家。

en: There has been a gradual change in the weather this month.
exzh: 這個月天氣逐漸在改變。

en: My grandmother believes her cat is now in heaven.
exzh: 我奶奶相信她的貓現在在天堂。

en: We visited many historical buildings on our class trip.
exzh: 我們在校外教學時參觀了許多歷史建築。

en: Amy's speech in English was very impressive.
exzh: Amy 的英文演講令人印象深刻。

en: Please give a short introduction about yourself to the class.
exzh: 請向全班簡短介紹你自己。

en: The keeper feeds the animals at the zoo every morning.
exzh: 管理員每天早上餵動物園的動物。

en: My grandmother lives on a quiet lane near the market.
exzh: 我奶奶住在市場附近一條安靜的小巷裡。

en: Lisa showed great leadership as our class leader.
exzh: Lisa 擔任班長時展現了優秀的領導力。

en: Ben helped his dad load the boxes into the car.
exzh: Ben 幫爸爸把箱子裝上車。

en: Good luck on your English test tomorrow!
exzh: 祝你明天英文考試好運！

en: Amy is very mature for her age.
exzh: 以她的年紀來說，Amy 很成熟。

en: The drink is a mixture of milk and tea.
exzh: 這杯飲料是牛奶和茶的混合。

en: Ben is in a good mood because he won the game.
exzh: Ben 心情很好，因為他贏了比賽。

en: We had lunch at a nearby restaurant.
exzh: 我們在附近的一家餐廳吃午餐。

en: It is often rainy in northern Taiwan in winter.
exzh: 台灣北部冬天常下雨。

en: It was obvious that Lisa was tired after the race.
exzh: 很明顯 Lisa 賽跑後很累。

en: Many students take online classes during summer vacation.
exzh: 很多學生在暑假期間上線上課程。

en: The machine operator showed us how it works.
exzh: 機器操作員向我們示範它如何運作。

en: This milk tea costs fifty dollars per cup.
exzh: 這款奶茶每杯五十元。

en: The poet wrote a beautiful poem about the moon.
exzh: 這位詩人寫了一首關於月亮的優美詩作。

en: There is a possibility of rain this afternoon.
exzh: 今天下午有可能下雨。

en: Before dinner, the family says a short prayer.
exzh: 晚餐前，這家人會做簡短的禱告。

en: My parents felt great pride when I won the prize.
exzh: 我得獎時，我爸媽感到非常自豪。

en: Always wear protective glasses in science class.
exzh: 上自然課時一定要戴護目鏡。

en: The city has seen rapid growth in recent years.
exzh: 這座城市近幾年快速成長。

en: Taiwan has good relations with many countries.
exzh: 台灣和許多國家關係良好。

en: Amy has a close relationship with her older sister.
exzh: Amy 和她姊姊關係很親密。

en: People of every religion are welcome at this school.
exzh: 這所學校歡迎各種宗教信仰的人。

en: Lisa didn't respond to my message last night.
exzh: Lisa 昨晚沒有回我訊息。

en: Many people watched the royal wedding on TV.
exzh: 許多人在電視上觀看了皇室婚禮。

en: Ben is the fastest runner in our class.
exzh: Ben 是我們班跑得最快的人。

en: This soup is too salty for me to drink.
exzh: 這碗湯太鹹了，我喝不下。

en: Please write your name, age, and sex on this form.
exzh: 請在這張表格上寫下你的姓名、年齡和性別。

en: We collected many shells on the beach.
exzh: 我們在海灘上撿了很多貝殼。

en: Ben made the winning shot at the end of the game.
exzh: Ben 在比賽最後投進了致勝的一球。

en: My uncle is a skilled cook who makes great noodles.
exzh: 我叔叔是個很厲害的廚師，煮的麵很好吃。

en: The test was somewhat harder than I expected.
exzh: 這次考試比我預期的稍微難一點。

en: This drink is made from soybeans and a little sugar.
exzh: 這種飲料是用黃豆和一點糖做的。

en: Our math teacher is very strict about homework.
exzh: 我們的數學老師對作業非常嚴格。

en: The surface of the table is smooth.
exzh: 這張桌子的表面很光滑。

en: Please switch off the lights when you leave the room.
exzh: 離開房間時請把燈關掉。

en: My target is to read one English book every month.
exzh: 我的目標是每個月讀一本英文書。

en: I sent Amy a text to say I would be late.
exzh: 我傳了簡訊給 Amy 說我會晚到。

en: Can I have a tissue? My nose is running.
exzh: 可以給我一張面紙嗎？我在流鼻水。

en: How much does this box of books weigh?
exzh: 這箱書有多重？

en: Many Taiwanese teens enjoy western food like pizza.
exzh: 許多台灣青少年喜歡像披薩這樣的西式食物。

en: You can order whatever you like from the menu.
exzh: 你可以點菜單上任何你喜歡的東西。

en: Lisa whispered a secret into my ear.
exzh: Lisa 在我耳邊悄悄說了一個秘密。

en: To whom should I give this letter?
exzh: 我應該把這封信交給誰？

en: Please measure the width of the window.
exzh: 請量一下窗戶的寬度。

en: Ben is always willing to help his classmates.
exzh: Ben 總是願意幫助同學。

en: There is a wooden table in our kitchen.
exzh: 我們的廚房裡有一張木桌。

en: The new museum in Taipei is really worth a visit.
exzh: 台北那間新博物館真的很值得一去。

en: Ben finally admitted that he broke the window.
exzh: Ben 終於承認是他打破了窗戶。

en: Students should pay attention to world affairs.
exzh: 學生應該關心國際事務。

en: You can call me anytime if you need help.
exzh: 如果你需要幫忙，隨時可以打給我。

en: Apes are smart animals that can use tools.
exzh: 猿是會使用工具的聰明動物。

en: I lost my appetite when I had a cold.
exzh: 我感冒時沒有胃口。

en: Follow the arrows to find the way to the gym.
exzh: 跟著箭頭走就能找到去體育館的路。

en: I read an interesting article about sleep in the newspaper.
exzh: 我在報紙上讀到一篇關於睡眠的有趣文章。

en: Amy ate a chocolate bar after school.
exzh: Amy 放學後吃了一條巧克力棒。

en: My little brother begged Mom to buy him a toy.
exzh: 我弟弟苦苦哀求媽媽買玩具給他。

en: Bend your knees when you pick up heavy boxes.
exzh: 搬重箱子時要彎曲膝蓋。

en: Grandma made biscuits for us to eat with tea.
exzh: 奶奶做了餅乾讓我們配茶吃。

en: The principal gave a brief speech at the meeting.
exzh: 校長在集會上做了簡短的致詞。

en: Let's study together at the cafe near the station.
exzh: 我們一起去車站附近的咖啡館讀書吧。

en: Camels can live in the desert without water for days.
exzh: 駱駝可以在沙漠中好幾天不喝水。

en: This old movie is a classic that everyone should watch.
exzh: 這部老電影是每個人都該看的經典。

en: Click this button to watch the video.
exzh: 點這個按鈕來看影片。

en: A cup of hot cocoa is perfect on a cold day.
exzh: 冷天裡來一杯熱可可再完美不過。

en: We ordered pizza for delivery last night.
exzh: 我們昨晚叫了披薩外送。

en: Ben denied eating the last piece of cake.
exzh: Ben 否認吃了最後一塊蛋糕。

en: Write a short description of your best friend.
exzh: 寫一段簡短的文字描述你最好的朋友。

en: We practiced the dialogue in pairs during English class.
exzh: 英文課時我們兩人一組練習對話。

en: Division is harder than addition for my little brother.
exzh: 對我弟弟來說，除法比加法難。

en: Domestic flights are cheaper than flights to other countries.
exzh: 國內航班比飛往其他國家的航班便宜。

en: My little sister gave me a drawing of our family.
exzh: 我妹妹送我一張她畫的全家福。

en: The movie was so dull that I fell asleep.
exzh: 這部電影無聊到我睡著了。

en: The new edition of this dictionary has more words.
exzh: 這本字典的新版收錄了更多單字。

en: My employer lets me work only on weekends.
exzh: 我的老闆讓我只在週末上班。

en: Do you know the exact time the movie starts?
exzh: 你知道電影確切幾點開始嗎？

en: Some people believe in the existence of ghosts.
exzh: 有些人相信鬼的存在。

en: Food is the biggest expense for my family each month.
exzh: 食物是我家每個月最大的開銷。

en: Amy raised her eyebrows when she heard the surprising news.
exzh: Amy 聽到這個驚人的消息時揚起了眉毛。

en: Failure is a part of learning, so don't give up.
exzh: 失敗是學習的一部分，所以不要放棄。

en: Ben is a friendly fellow who gets along with everyone.
exzh: Ben 是個友善的傢伙，跟每個人都處得來。

en: The fireman saved a cat from the burning house.
exzh: 消防員從失火的房子裡救出一隻貓。

en: We learned a Taiwanese folk song in music class.
exzh: 我們在音樂課學了一首台灣民謠。

en: My mom always adds garlic to the fried noodles.
exzh: 我媽媽總是在炒麵裡加大蒜。

en: The giraffe has a very long neck.
exzh: 長頸鹿有很長的脖子。

en: Rice is the main grain eaten in Taiwan.
exzh: 稻米是台灣人主要吃的穀物。

en: The school held a grand opening for the new library.
exzh: 學校為新圖書館舉辦了盛大的開幕典禮。

en: Moving to college gave my sister a sense of independence.
exzh: 上大學搬出去住讓我姊姊有了獨立的感覺。

en: Read the instructions carefully before you start the test.
exzh: 開始考試前請仔細閱讀說明。

en: The internal parts of the machine are very small.
exzh: 這台機器內部的零件非常小。

en: My grandfather has pain in his knee joints.
exzh: 我爺爺的膝關節會痛。

en: I write in my journal every night before bed.
exzh: 我每晚睡前都會寫日誌。

en: The people fought for justice and equal rights.
exzh: 人民為正義和平等的權利而奮鬥。

en: A little red ladybug landed on my hand.
exzh: 一隻紅色的小瓢蟲停在我的手上。

en: The cat is sleeping on my lap.
exzh: 貓正睡在我的大腿上。

en: Is it legal to ride a bike on the sidewalk?
exzh: 在人行道上騎腳踏車合法嗎？

en: The camera lens is dirty, so the photos look bad.
exzh: 相機鏡頭髒了，所以照片看起來很糟。

en: Amy is a good listener, so friends tell her everything.
exzh: Amy 很會傾聽，所以朋友什麼都跟她說。

en: Drinking too much is bad for your liver.
exzh: 飲酒過量對肝臟不好。

en: A lone tree stands on top of the hill.
exzh: 山丘頂上孤零零地立著一棵樹。

en: Ben has a membership card for the bookstore.
exzh: Ben 有那家書店的會員卡。

en: Only a minority of students walk to school.
exzh: 只有少數學生走路上學。

en: Dad drinks coffee from his big blue mug.
exzh: 爸爸用他的藍色大馬克杯喝咖啡。

en: It took a lot of nerve to sing in front of everyone.
exzh: 在大家面前唱歌需要很大的勇氣。

en: Never share your phone password with anyone, even friends.
exzh: 絕對不要把手機密碼告訴任何人，即使是朋友。

en: Lisa enjoys reading poetry in her free time.
exzh: Lisa 空閒時喜歡讀詩。

en: The thief was sent to prison for two years.
exzh: 那個小偷被判入獄兩年。

en: The prisoners work in the garden every morning.
exzh: 囚犯們每天早上在菜園裡工作。

en: Wear proper shoes when you go hiking.
exzh: 去健行時要穿合適的鞋子。

en: After dinner, Mom made chocolate pudding for us.
exzh: 晚餐後，媽媽做了巧克力布丁給我們吃。

en: The teacher has thirty pupils in her class.
exzh: 這位老師班上有三十名學生。

en: The store sells rice in large quantities.
exzh: 這家店大量販售稻米。

en: Amy didn't reply to my message until midnight.
exzh: Amy 直到半夜才回我訊息。

en: The king had great riches but no real friends.
exzh: 國王擁有龐大的財富，卻沒有真正的朋友。

en: We walked carefully along the rocky beach.
exzh: 我們小心地沿著多岩石的海灘走。

en: The rooster wakes up the whole farm every morning.
exzh: 公雞每天早上叫醒整座農場。

en: The saleswoman helped me find the right size of shoes.
exzh: 女店員幫我找到尺寸合適的鞋子。

en: The loud thunder scared my little dog.
exzh: 巨大的雷聲嚇壞了我的小狗。

en: This shop has a wide selection of comic books.
exzh: 這家店有各式各樣的漫畫可供選擇。

en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
exzh: 小心不要在濕地板上滑倒。

en: Plants need good soil and water to grow.
exzh: 植物需要好的土壤和水才能生長。

en: The weather in southern Taiwan is warm all year.
exzh: 台灣南部一年四季都很溫暖。

en: We have a spelling test every Friday.
exzh: 我們每週五都有拼字測驗。

en: Water is necessary for the survival of all living things.
exzh: 水是所有生物生存所必需的。

en: Grandma told us an old tale about a brave girl.
exzh: 奶奶跟我們說了一個勇敢女孩的古老故事。

en: Many young people in their teens love video games.
exzh: 許多十幾歲的年輕人熱愛電玩。

en: Many countries work together to fight terrorism.
exzh: 許多國家合作打擊恐怖主義。

en: Airports check bags carefully to stop terrorist attacks.
exzh: 機場仔細檢查行李以阻止恐怖攻擊。

en: Dad changed the tire on our car this morning.
exzh: 爸爸今天早上換了我們車子的輪胎。

en: Don't talk to your mother in that tone.
exzh: 不要用那種語氣跟你媽媽說話。

en: Amy was upset because she lost her phone.
exzh: Amy 很難過，因為她弄丟了手機。

en: This phone is easy for new users to learn.
exzh: 這支手機對新使用者來說很容易上手。

en: My dog follows me wherever I go.
exzh: 無論我去哪裡，我的狗都跟著我。

en: Whoever finishes first can go home early.
exzh: 誰先完成就可以先回家。

en: Don't touch that wire; it may be dangerous.
exzh: 不要碰那條電線，它可能很危險。

en: This warm sweater is made of wool.
exzh: 這件保暖的毛衣是羊毛做的。

en: Many stores in Taiwan sell hot baked yams in winter.
exzh: 台灣許多商店冬天會賣熱騰騰的烤地瓜。
